text:
Priya Singh: Kickoff for June webinar planning  working title: 'Practical Inference Playbook: From prototype to SLA'. Need short abstract options + final speaker slate. Thoughts?
Maria Chen: Love that. Goal is platform engineers + engineering managers. Prefer 3 segments: customer story, ops playbook, hands-on troubleshooting lab. 45-60min total.
Alex Park: Suggest 12m customer story / 15m ops playbook / 20m guided lab / 10m live debug Q&A. Keep total to 57m so ops team can run over for follow-ups.
Jonah Lee: Can we add a single benchmark slide comparing median p95 latency and $/1M tokens across two configs (baseline vs optimized)? I can compute numbers but need the prompt set. Maria, can you share a 6-8 prompt list?
Priya Singh: I'll draft 6 prompts focusing on: short chat, long-form summarization, semantic search, code continuation, instruction-following, and multi-turn context. Also need 2 speaker abstracts (short).
Samir Patel: I can take the ops playbook. Outline: traffic shaping, batching configs, KV cache warmup, graceful fallback to cheaper variants. Will include a quick cli snippet for autoscaler config.
Carla Gomez: Customer story available: Acme's migration from v1 to Redwood Optimize. I can do live Q&A but will prepare a 90s recorded fallback demo in case of regressions.
Priya Singh: Abstract A (customer-first): "How Acme cut inference cost 3x while maintaining latency with pragmatic batching and model routing" (one-liner).
Priya Singh: Abstract B (workshop-first): "A hands-on playbook for deploying LLM features that meet latency SLAs and budget targets" (one-liner).
Maria Chen: Both good. Marketing prefers B as headline, A as subline/case-study. Need speaker bios (50-75 words) and headshots by May 22. Carla and Samir, can you provide?
Carla Gomez: Yep - I'll drop bio + headshot in the folder by EOD May 20.
Samir Patel: Will do. Also tagging @DevRel-bot for example code packaging and sandbox creds.
DevRel-bot: Packaging job started: building demo repos (cheap-config, fidelity-config) and a seed dataset for the lab. ETA 48h.
Alex Park: Rehearsal slots: propose Jun 1 full run, Jun 6 tech-check + mic test. Can we lock Jun 6 9:30am PT for tech-check? @calendar-bot create events and invite speakers.
calendar-bot: Events created: "Jun 1 Full Rehearsal" and "Jun 6 Tech Check (mic + recording)". Recordings enabled, file share attached.
Jonah Lee: Benchmarks: I'll run 7 runs on each prompt set across small/medium/large batch sizes and post median p50/p95 and cost-per-1M-tokens tomorrow. Will tag results in the shared folder.
Priya Singh: Inbound lead form fields (required): company name, email, company size, primary use case, expected monthly tokens, hosting preference (hosted/dedicated/private). Routing rules: <100k tokens -> SDR pool A; 100k-5M -> SDR pool B; >5M -> AE team. Samir to implement routing.
Samir Patel: I'll wire the form and add a hidden field to capture demo repo choice (cheap vs fidelity) for targeted follow-up. Sharing flow + test tomorrow.
Maria Chen: Rehearsal checklist (quick):
```
- Confirm slides + speaker deck order
- Upload fallback clips for every live demo
- Test recording + slideshare permissions
- Validate lab sandbox credentials and cleanup script
- Confirm poll questions and QA channel routing
- Smoke test inbound form + routing
```
Alex Park: Also add a revert plan for the live demo: if model endpoint > p95 threshold, swap to recorded demo and switch the lab to a pre-seeded response set. Samir please prepare pre-seeded responses.
Samir Patel: Will prepare the pre-seeded response bundle and a short runbook for swap steps.
Carla Gomez: One ask: can we add a 1-question quick poll mid-session asking what their biggest inference pain is? (cost / latency / ops / quality). We'll use results in follow-up comms.
Maria Chen: Yes. Marketing will own the poll copy and follow-up nurture. Also propose 3 CTAs: watch recording, get a tailored cost estimate, join a Dedicated capacity trial.
Priya Singh: Final nit: speaker order should include a 2-min bio preface for guest speakers so attendees have context.
Maria Chen: Agreed. Locking run-of-show draft now. Final items: speaker bios + headshots, lab sandbox link, benchmark numbers, inbound form wired. Rehearsal invites are out. Will post final runbook after rehearsals. :rocket:
